# 274 reference-cache manifest — Engine-TS 4c95f87e + Content 37607266 (pinned upstream toolchain).
# Packed 2026-07-16 via Server274-ref worktrees (Node 24 toolchain, npm run build).
# gzip members are stock zlib 1.3.1 level-6 (OS byte zeroed) — see pkg/io/gziputil CompressSZGz (T17b).
#
# Scope: these are the files goscape's PackAll emits that have a 274 reference
# counterpart — the Jag store (main_file_cache.dat + idx0-4), the loose client
# jags (client/*), the loose server config (server/*.dat/.idx), and the
# worldmap (mapview/worldmap.jag). All 56 match the Node-built 274 reference
# byte-for-byte.
#
# NOT in the manifest (build-infra the 274 Node toolchain emits but goscape
# does not — documented NOT-PORTED, see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-12-
# rev274-port-design.md and pkg/pack/map/Pack.js @dee467c8):
#   - data/pack/.cache/*  — ArtifactCache incremental-build stores
#                           (maps-client.zip / maps-server.zip / *.manifest.json
#                           / model_flags/*.bin). The map BYTES they cache are
#                           covered: client land/loc live in the Jag store
#                           (arch4, byte-identical above); and the parity test
#                           cross-checks goscape's loose maps tree against these
#                           zip entries (assertion C).
#   - data/pack/.stamps/* — FsCache source-snapshot stamps.
#
# goscape ALSO emits a loose maps tree (client/maps/*, server/maps/*) — its own
# pack layout. The 274 reference packs maps into the Jag store + .cache zips
# instead (no loose maps tree). The loose tree is validated against the .cache
# artifact zips in the parity test (assertion C); it is allowlisted in the
# extra-files walk (assertion B).
#
# Excludes data/symbols entirely: upstream has no .sym pipeline (symbols live
# in-memory in @lostcityrs/runescript); goscape's .sym export is a documented
# Go-only feature with no upstream baseline (self-consistency-tested).
